concerns.text: Task T003 expects a checksum manifest `data/checksums/manifest.sha256` but the file is missing, violating Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and breaking reproducibility.
Task T004 requires `data/processed/window_index.csv` to exist and contain 300 rows; the artifact is missing or empty, breaching FR‑001/FR‑002 data‑flow and Constitution Principle III.
Task T005 mandates `data/processed/demo_autocorr.csv` for the US‑1 demo; the file does not exist, leaving US‑1’s independent verification and SC‑001 unsupported, violating Constitution Principle I.
Task T006 specifies generation of `data/processed/autocorrelation_raw.csv`; the file is absent, so FR‑002 and the runtime/memory success criteria (SC‑003, SC‑004) are not satisfied.

Task T007 (Constitution VI) reports execution failure of `code/permutation.py`; without a successful run the required 1,000 permutations per window (FR‑003) and Constitution VII (Statistical Null Validation) are unmet.

Task T008 expects `autocorrelation_stats.csv` to contain an `adjusted_p_value` column after Benjamini–Hochberg correction; the column is missing, violating FR‑004, SC‑002 and breaking the declared pipeline.
Task T009 (cross‑validation) failed, so Constitution VI (Deterministic Arithmetic) and the cross‑validation acceptance criterion are not met.

The implementation plan limits the permutation engine to 500 permutations per selected window (20 windows per length), whereas the specification (FR‑003 and Constitution VII) mandates 1,000 permutations for **every** window, constituting a direct weakening of the requirement.
Success Criterion SC‑001 contains a placeholder `[deferred]` instead of a concrete numeric target, rendering the criterion untestable and thus violating the requirement that all SCs be measurable.

Task T001 creates `quickstart.md`, which is not referenced by any functional requirement or acceptance criterion in the spec, representing an orphan task (scope creep) without documented justification.
